sys.title: System status
sys.text.offline: Can’t reach gbs-anywhere. Is it running, and is this phone on the same network?
sys.text.checking: The grinder is taking the result: step 3 of 3.
sys.text.knob: Ground. Press the grinder’s rotary knob to start the shot: step 1 of 3.
sys.text.needsId: The grinder is paired, but its pairing ID is missing here: enter it above.
sys.text.pairing: Accept gbs-anywhere on the grinder to pair it.
sys.text.error: The last shot did not reach the grinder.
sys.text.problem: The grinder answers, but turned down the last request. gbs-anywhere keeps trying.
sys.text.integError: {title} is not working right now. You can still grind and enter the shot by hand.
sys.text.done: The last shot reached the grinder {ago}. Ready for the next one.
sys.text.doneNoTime: The last shot reached the grinder. Ready for the next one.
sys.text.aborted: Shot aborted. Grind again to start the next one.
sys.missing.e64: The grinder is not polling. Is it switched on and paired with gbs-anywhere (it appears as ‘Xenia’ on the grinder)?
sys.missing.wifi: The grinder does not answer. Is it switched on? gbs-anywhere reconnects by itself as soon as it can reach it.
sys.missing.linkError: The grinder answers, but the connection is not working right now. gbs-anywhere keeps trying.
pair.accept.title: Accept gbs-anywhere on the grinder
pair.id.title: Enter the pairing ID
pair.id.label: Pairing ID
pair.id.range: The pairing ID is a number from 1 to 65535.
pair.id.unknown: The grinder did not take pairing ID {id}. Check the number it shows and enter it again.
pair.accept.text: On the grinder, open Connectivity → Machine To Machine → Generic WiFi → Configuration, tap Start Pairing, then Accept Pairing.
pair.id.text: The grinder has gbs-anywhere paired, but its pairing ID is missing here. The grinder shows it as Pairing ID under Generic WiFi → Configuration.
start.step1.title: Grind with the Grind-by-Sync recipe
start.step1.ready.e64: Grind with a GbS recipe, then press the grinder’s rotary knob and start the shot on the machine right away.
start.step1.ready.wifi:
Grind with a GbS recipe.
gbs-anywhere notices it by itself.
start.step1.knobRest: , then start the shot on the machine right away.
start.step2.title: Pull the shot on the espresso machine
start.step2.info.manual: No machine integration reports shots here, so enter the time and weight you measured, timed from the moment the pump starts.

start.step2.info.auto.one: {names} sends the shot’s time and weight a few seconds after it ends.
start.step2.info.auto.other: {names} send the shot’s time and weight a few seconds after it ends.

start.step2.info.limit: Without a shot within {window}, the grinder is told it was cancelled.

start.step2.missed.one: No shot from {names} yet. If it missed this one, enter it yourself.
start.step2.missed.other: No shot from {names} yet. If they missed this one, enter it yourself.

start.step2.failed.one: {names} is not working right now, so enter the shot yourself.
start.step2.failed.other: {names} are not working right now, so enter the shot yourself.

start.step2.flush: Started without a grinder request: the grinder counts it as a flush.
start.form.tooShort.e64: {limit} s or less: the grinder ignores this shot and asks you to go finer yourself.
start.form.tooShort.wifi: {limit} s or less: that far below the target time, the grinder ignores the shot. Grind finer by hand.
start.form.tooLong.e64: Over {limit} s: the grinder ignores this shot.
start.form.tooLong.wifi: Over {limit} s: that far above the target time, the grinder ignores the shot.
start.abort.title: Abort the shot?
start.abort.text: The grinder ignores this shot and keeps its grind setting.
start.error.stoppedWaiting: The grinder stopped waiting before the shot came
start.error.unknownApp: The grinder no longer knows this gbs-anywhere
start.error.generic: The shot did not reach the grinder
start.error.hint.before: Need more time? Raise the limit under
start.error.cancelled: The shot was cancelled. Grind again to start over at Step 1.
start.aborted.user: Aborted in the app. The grinder skips this shot.
start.aborted.address: Ended: the grinder address changed. Grind again to start over at Step 1.
start.aborted.replaced: Replaced by a newer grind. That grind is the next shot.
start.step3.title: Grinder checks and adjusts the grind
start.step3.wait: The grinder compares the shot with the recipe and adjusts.
start.step3.skip: Nothing to check: no shot reached the grinder. The grind setting stays as it was.
outcome.tooShort: {time} s is too short: the grinder ignores it
outcome.tooLong: {time} s is too long: the grinder ignores it
outcome.compares: it compares the shot with the recipe
outcome.onTarget: likely on target (shot: {time} s, target: {target} s)
integ.title: Machine integrations
integ.empty: None set up: you enter each shot’s time and weight by hand on the Start tab. An integration can report them for you; tap + to add one.
integ.pick.title: What reports your shots?
integ.pick.text: Optional: it sends the time and weight to the grinder after each shot, so you don’t have to type them.
integ.notSaved: Not saved: gbs-anywhere runs without a settings file (--config), so this integration is gone after a restart.

integ.reports.one: {n} shot sent to the grinder this session
integ.reports.other: {n} shots sent to the grinder this session

integ.cmdOnly.title: {title} comes from the start settings
integ.cmdOnly.text: This integration comes from the start settings (environment variables or flags), so it can only be changed or removed there.
integ.cmdOnly.noFile: Moving it into the app needs a settings file (--config).
integ.adopt.title: Move {title} into the app?
integ.adopt.text: This integration comes from the start settings (environment variables or flags). Move it into the app to change it here? Its settings are taken over; nothing has to be typed again.
integ.adopt.textPassword: This integration comes from the start settings (environment variables or flags). Move it into the app to change it here? Its settings, including the password, are taken over; nothing has to be typed again.
integ.adopt.after: From the next start on, its flags or environment variables are ignored for as long as it is in the app. You can remove them.
integ.delete.title: Delete {title}?
integ.delete.text: This stops the integration and removes its saved settings. Shots are then no longer reported by themselves.
integ.delete.textPassword: This stops the integration and removes its saved settings, including the password. Shots are then no longer reported by themselves.
integ.delete.moved: It was moved into the app from the start settings. If its flags or environment variables are still set, they start it again at the next start; remove them to turn it off for good.
integ.passwordSaved: Saved. Leave this empty to keep the saved password.
settings.title: Settings
settings.windowSub: after the grind, before a timeout
settings.windowInvalid: Type a time from {min} to {max} min: a whole number is minutes up to 60 and seconds above (3 or 150), one with decimals is minutes ({decimal}); or write 2:30 or 150 s. 0 is no limit.
settings.from.app: Set in the app · start setting: {value}
settings.hostHelp: The address of an E65/E80 GbS (Generic WiFi). Leave it empty when you use an E64 WS.
settings.saved: The settings for time to pull the shot, the grinder IP address and the update check are saved on the computer (gbs-anywhere host) and kept after a restart. “Use start setting” goes back to the value of the environment variable or flag, else the default. Appearance and language apply to this device only.
settings.notPersistent: The settings for time to pull the shot, the grinder IP address and the update check apply until the next restart: gbs-anywhere runs without a settings file (--config). “Use start setting” goes back to the value of the environment variable or flag, else the default. Appearance and language apply to this device only.

history.noMatch: No shots match the filter. Tap a status above to show it again.

history.kept.other: The last {n} shots are kept on this computer.
